scope: Literal diagnostic emission sites, diagnostic declarations and conversion helpers in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pdf, Markdown and their adapters; includes legacy import, inspection and authoring diagnostics used by these formats. Shared Core/HTML catalogs are included when forwarded by adapters. Tests, benchmarks and smoke projects are excluded.
migrationNotes: Map codes at emission sites in M2; this file does not change existing converter behavior.
Preserve each diagnostic severity, location, format and loss kind. A warning can be loss-free and an informational finding can carry loss.

chart-projected is the verified shared native flat-projection diagnostic and maps to chart-flattened. NativeBodyChartSimplified, ExcelChartKindApproximated and chart-approximation are broader: split them at their M2 emission sites, using chart-flattened only for an actual flat projection.
Dynamic forwarding sites include user-supplied extension codes and feature codes; they are evidence for M2 review, not additional finite code definitions.
Legacy loss policies and typed report/result deletion candidates are in api-migration-map.json.

NativeFontFamilySubstituted and WorksheetFontFamilySubstituted use the same PDF substitution warning factory and map to font-family-substitution. NativeBodyChartQuality and chart-quality both report shared renderer quality findings and map to chart-quality.
